ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 75% high-intensity white pixels and 25% low-intensity black/dark-gray pixels localized at the center and edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity dark region at the peduncle spreading outward into the lobes; high-intensity white contiguous zones across the mid-lateral lobes; dark pixel clusters concentrated along the trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 65 degrees and a narrow vertex depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern with variable amplitudes (2-15 pixels); significant irregular peaks and deep valleys across the entire trailing boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex upward curve following a parabolic trajectory from the notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Left lobe contains a cluster of five dark circular spots near the inner-lower quadrant; right lobe displays two distinct high-contrast concentric ring marks (bullseyes) on the white field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Right lobe exhibits a prominent intersecting 'X' shaped linear disruption and several vertical parallel dark rake marks; left lobe shows fainter horizontal linear pixel disruptions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular serration and missing tissue segments on the distal outer edges of both lobes; distinct circular barnacle attachment scars on both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive high-contrast 'X' mark on the right lobe and a dark circular ring scar in the upper-right quadrant of the right lobe.
